entities.summary: Yuriy Kaplan (b. 1988-10-02, Zaporizhzhia) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zaporizhzhia and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
